description: Fetch one public URL and return its main content as clean markdown (title, publish date, word count) plus a prompt-injection verdict; raw=true returns the raw body instead (text or base64). Give `text` instead of `url` to only scan text you already have for prompt injection. To find pages first use web_search. Price: read $0.004, raw $0.003, text scan $0.002. Fetched live via Cloudflare's network; 1-10 s. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

html.description: Optional HTML of that text, to also find hidden instructions.

raw.description: true = raw body (no cleanup), default false.

text.description: Instead of url: text to scan for prompt injection.

name: web_read
title: Read a URL as clean text (or check text for prompt injection)
